name: Internal Monologue
source:
We are nothing more than the matter that makes us. But society views us differently based on the shape and size and colour of the matter that makes us!

Talk to your organs to try to understand how to feel about your own identity and how to help yourself be yourself.

[From [url=https://keroblin.itch.io/internal-monologue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们不过是构成我们的物质而已。但社会根据构成我们的物质的形状、大小和颜色对我们有不同的看法！

与你的器官交谈，尝试了解如何感受自己的身份以及如何帮助自己做你自己。

[来自[url=https://keroblin.itch.io/internal-monologue]itch.io[/url]]
